sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Great depression ; worse in morning or eve-
ning. Cannot study. Cross, irritable, restless. Bewild-
ered. Mental confusion and apathy. Desires to be alone.
Difficulty in concentrating mind, absent-minded. Lack of
ambition. Defective expression in writing. Restlessness
and aimless wandering. Must concentrate his mind on
vvalking.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Diplopia. Burning in eyes. Cracking of
lower lip.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Aches. Feels full. Sore with nausea.
Pharynx dark, swollen, glazed.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : Astra (/alius and Oxytropis,
two varieties of Loco Weed; also Baryta.
